description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a method for logging data in a modular logging chain within an Android application.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging component that outputs log data to one or more targets and can be chained with other log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Defines a method to log messages with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
